Volume - 159 BENGALURU, TUESDAY, 26, NOVEMBER, 2024(MARGASHIRA, 05, SHAKAVARSHA, 1946) Issue 227

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
No: SWD 97 PKS 2022 Karnataka Government Secretary,
Vikasa Soudha,
Bangalore, dated:21.11.2024

NOTIFICATION

The draft of the following rules to amend the Karnataka State Department of Social Welfare
(Scheduled Castes Welfare) Service (Cadre and Recruitment)Rules, 2022, which the Government of
Karnataka proposes to make in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3 read
with section 8 of the Karnataka State Civil Services Act, 1978 (Karnataka Act 14 of 1990) is hereby
published as required by clause (a) of sub-section (2) of section 3 of the said Act for the information
of all the persons likely to be affected thereby and notice is hereby given that the said draft will be
taken into consideration after the expiry of fifteen days from the date of its publication in the official
gazette.

Any objection or suggestion, which may be received by the State Government from any person
with respect to the said draft before the expiry of the period specified above will be considered by the
State Government Objections and suggestions may be addressed to the Principal Secretary to
Government, Social Welfare Department, Vikasa Soudha, Bengaluru-560 001.
DRAFT RULES
1. Title and Commencement :- (1) These rules may be called the Karnataka State Department of
Social Welfare (Scheduled Caste Welfare) Service (Cadre and Recruitment) (Amendment)
Rules, 2024.
(2) They shall come into force from the date of their final publication in the official
Gazette.
2. Amendment to the Schedule : In the Karnataka State Department of Social Welfare
(Scheduled Castes Welfare) Service (Cadre and Recruitment) Rules, 2022 in the Schedule-I, -
(19191)

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RC-CFS0ADMN/48/2023-RC
E-1255507 Dated 17/01/2024 regarding altering the limits of Devasamudra village of
Kampli Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village called
Krishnanagar Camp was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land

Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated:
25/01/2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected
thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette
addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 02/02/2024; And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Devasamudra of Kampli Taluk and Ballari District to form a new revenue
village called as Krishnanagar Camp of Kampli Taluk in Ballari District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RC-CFS0ADMN/49/2024-RC
E- 1255619 Dated :17/01/2024 regarding altering the limits of Metri village of
Kampli Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village called
Chinnapura was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated:25/01/2024
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 02/02/2024.; And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Metri of Kampli Taluk and Ballari District to form a new revenue village
called as Chinnapura of Kampli Taluk in Ballari District along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No RC-CFS0ADMN/157/2024-RC
E-1301097 Dated:01/02/2024 regarding altering the limits of Suggenahalli Village of
Kampli Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village called
Sriramarangapura was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette
Dated:07/02/2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 12/02/2024. And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been
received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Suggenahalli Village of Kampli Taluk and Ballari District to form a new revenue
village called as Sriramarangapura Village of Kampli Taluk and Ballari District
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RCCFSOADMN/161/2024-
RCE -1301378. Date: 03-02-2024 regarding altering the limits of Somasamudra
village of Kurugodu Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue

village called Madire was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Date:21-
02-2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected
thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette
addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 02-03-2024; And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Somasamudra of Kurugodu Taluk and Ballari District to form a new
revenue village called as Madire of Kurugodu Taluk in Ballari District along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RC-CFS0ADMN/163/2024-RC
E-1301472 Dated 01/02/2024 regarding altering the limits of No.2-Muddapur Village
of Kampli Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village called
R.Kondaiah camp was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated
17/02/2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 22/02/2024. And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been
received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
No.2-Muddapur Village of Kampli Taluk and Ballari District to form a new revenue
village called as R.Kondaiah camp Village of Kampli Taluk and Ballari District
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Ugar Budruk Village of
KAGAWAD Taluk, Belagavi District and to constitute a new revenue villages
called PARMESHWARAWADI as specified in schedule along with maps with
old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Belagavi
District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Ugar Budruk Village of Kagawad taluk in Belagavi District to form a new revenue
village called PARMESHWARAWADI Village of KAGAWAD Taluk, Belagavi
District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No.RC-CFS0ADMN/209/2024-
RC,Dated:05-03-2024 regarding altering the limits of Ankasandra village of
Chikkanayakanahalli Taluk in Tumkuru District and constituting a new revenue sub
village called as Ankasandra Gollarahatti sub village was published as required by
section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in
the Karnataka Gazette Dated: 27-06-2024inviting objections or suggestions from all
the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its
publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Tumkuru
district.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:29-06-2024;And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE

Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of Ankasandra Gollarahatti village of
Chikkanayakanahalli Taluk in Tumakuru District convert the same to form hamlet
within the boundary of Ankasandra revenue village and same will here in after be
named as called Ankasandra Gollarahatti of Ankasandra village in
Chikkanayakanahalli Taluk of Tumkuru District.

NOTIFICATION

As per the directions in the 1st meeting of State Level Coordination
Committee (SLCC) constituted for monitoring of implementation of the PM Surya
Ghar Scheme, Government of Karnataka hereby notifies Karnataka Renewable
Energy Development Limited (KREDL) as the ‘Nodal agency’ for executing solar
rooftop projects on Government Building through PPP Model under PM Surya
Ghar Scheme.

KREDL to execute the projects under PPP in accordance with the MNRE
guidelines issued from time to time, and in coordination with the Public Works
Department and ESCOMs.

BY ORDER AND IN THE NAME OF
GOVERNOR OF KARNATAKA,

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 151 PFH 2022 Dated:05-12-2022
regarding altering the limits of Virupasamudra village of Pavagada Taluk and
Tumkur District and constituting a new revenue sub village called as Nagalapura sub
village was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act,
1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated:06-12-2022
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Tumkuru district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 07-12-2022. And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of Nagalapura village of Pavagada Taluk in
Tumakuru District convert the same to form hamlet/part with in the boundary of
Virupasamudra revenue village and same will here in after be named as called
Nagalapura of Virupasamudra village in Pavagada Taluk of Tumkuru District.
